entries.title: Open L-Colonnade and Rest Corner
entries.description: One static open L-shaped colonnade corner: five complete unit-scale copies of one published fluted stone column define a turning inner walk, with a complete original slatted bench in a connected side rest pocket. All original column and bench geometry, nodes and solid PBR remain unchanged. Two closed scene-only meshes provide a chamfered stone ground and exact bedding under all four complete tilted bench-foot patches. Six bounded empty volumes connect the front entry, two colonnade walks, east return, central turn and bench-front space. One scene, zero new independent models; repeated columns are instances of one old model. No beam, roof, arch or covered corridor is included. The .15m outer base step needs external placement. Static game appearance only; no historical order, archaeological reconstruction, structural, load, stability, manufacturing, safety, accessibility, controller, navigation or old-module compatibility certification.

entries.title: Four-Wheel Mast Inspection Rover
entries.description: One original compact fixed inspection-robot visual prop. Four separate flat-facet polygonal wheels and four outer hub plates meet two continuous transverse axle bars below a chamfered low chassis. An independently editable continuous electronics housing has a broad lower shoulder and a tapered upper roof. A separate round mast seat, hexagonal upright and chamfered horizontal camera head form a clear elevated sensor silhouette. Two thick truly bored forward lens hoods surround separate fully backed recessed opaque lens discs. All nineteen meshes are closed, individually named and statically connected through complete finite opposed face patches. Five constant opaque unlinked PBR materials; no textures. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground origin centered between the wheel soles. Every profile and dimension is newly authored; no earlier vehicle, robot arm, trolley, camera, wheel or other geometry is imported, transformed or reused. One fixed static presentation only. No autonomy, operation, real sensing, optical imaging, communications, navigation, driving, steering, suspension, wheel motion, animation, rigging, power, controls, load capacity, stability, terrain suitability, manufacturing, safety or compatibility with prior mechanical assets is claimed.
